label: Refugees & asylum-seekers hosted (UNHCR)
source: UNHCR Refugee Data Finder via HDX (end-year stock, REF+ASY)
aggregation: sum of camp/settlement stocks in county
notes: End-of-year stock placed at July. Only counties hosting camps/settlements have values (Maban, Pariang, Juba, Yei, Ezo, Yambio, Tambura, Renk ...); refugees reported only at state level or 'dispersed' are not allocated. Renk/Wedwil/Boro Medina jump in 2023-25 = Sudan war arrivals.
